Through the window, in the house next door, another red rose stands straight and fresh in a vase on a windowsill. Both roses are rose red (the spot colour). No people. Quiet, a gentle mystery.

Format: ONE single wordless (silent) manga / graphic-novel panel that fills the whole canvas edge to edge: full bleed, no panel border, no gutter, no multi-panel page layout. Art style: bold confident black ink brush and pen linework, crisp cross-hatching and printed dot screentone (halftone) for all greys and shadows, on warm off-white paper (#F2EAD8). The image is essentially black ink on paper EXCEPT for ONE single spot accent colour, rose red (#E8435A), used sparingly only where the scene says; no other colours. Clear, readable composition, strong silhouettes, deep blacks, gentle, warm and curious mood suitable for children, a little mysterious but never scary. People are drawn from behind or as silhouettes, or only their hands; faces are never shown. Premium published graphic-novel quality.

ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OF ANY KIND ANYWHERE: no lettering, no speech balloons, no thought bubbles, no caption boxes, no narration boxes, no sound-effect lettering or onomatopoeia (neither Japanese kana/kanji nor Latin letters), no numbers or numerals (clocks, screens and dials are blank), no signs or signage, no labels, no brand names, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no panel number. Use only pictures, lines, tone and light. NO gore, NO blood, NO wounds, NO injuries shown, NO dead bodies, NO nudity, NO bare skin beyond hands, NO frightening faces.
